ゲームデザイナー小島秀夫公式ブログ「HIDEOBLOG」にて
配信されているWEBラジオ。
小島秀夫の「音声版HIDEOBLOG」として配信開始。
ゲームの事はもちろん、ゲームデザイナーの視点から
見た世界や、日常をお伝えしている。
過去番組タイトルは5回リニューアルされており、
現在ブログの総アクセスは「1000万アクセス」を突破した。
ポッドキャスティングによる配信も行われており、
過去200回を超える放送を今現在も全部聞くことが出来る。

小島秀夫監督プロフィール

小島秀夫  （  こじま ひでお  ） 

1963年8月24日東京世田谷生まれ。
1986年コナミにプランナーとして入社。
1987年初監督作品「メタルギア」でデビュー。
従来のアクションゲームを逆転の発想から昇華させた
「敵に見つからないように進む」というゲーム性は、
現在の「ステルスゲーム」と呼ばれるジャンルの
原点になっている。

その後「スナッチャー」「ポリスノーツ」など数々の
作品を世に送り出し、常に質の高い作品創りは多くの
ゲームファンの信頼を獲得していく。

そして1998年「メタルギア ソリッド」を発表。
2002年に続編「メタルギア ソリッド2 サンズ・オブ・リバティ」、
2004年には「メタルギア ソリッド3 スネークイーター」を発表。
2008年9月末現在「MGSシリーズ」は、
全世界でシリーズ累計2,600万本を記録している。

自らの監督作品の他、「METAL GEAR AC!D」シリーズ、
「ZONE OF THE ENDERS」シリーズや、「ボクらの太陽」シリーズの
企画、プロデュースも手がけるなど精力的に活動。

2008年6月、最新作「メタルギア ソリッド 4」を発売。
日本国内のPS3ソフトで最も売れているタイトル（※1）
となっている。ゲーム業界屈指の映画好きとしても知られ、
コメンテイターや映画評などの仕事もこなしている。

※1. 週刊ファミ通調べ。

Virtuous Mission, Operation Snake Eater

August 24, 1964. Thirty thousand feet above Pakistan, a man launches himself from a special ops Combat Talon aircraft emblazoned with the US flag. It is the first HALO
（high altitude, low opening） jump in history, and the beginning of the covert Virtuous Mission.

The plot thickens in Operation Snake Eater, a desperate mission with the fate of FOX at stake. With the doomsday weapon Shagohod finally complete, Snake enlists the aid of EVA, a beautiful and mysterious female spy sent to penetrate the GRU, to stop the Shagohod. Will Snake reach his objective in time?

San Hieronymo Incident

It is the era of détente, The FOX unit takes over a Soviet army base on the San Hieronymo Peninsula in central Colombia and launches a rebellion. Big Boss, now retired from FOX, is abducted by his former comrades and imprisoned in a cell on the peninsula. He escapes and, forming his own unit along with the local Soviet troops, sets out to put an end to FOX’s rebellion.

Developed for the PSP®, “Metal Gear Solid: Portable Ops” fills the gap between “Metal Gear Solid 3” and “Metal Gear” in the story of Big Boss.

Outer Heaven Uprising, Zanzibar Land Insurrection

FOXHOUND, a new Special Forces unit led by Big Boss, is dispatched to quell an uprising in the South African fortress state of Outer Heaven. Big Boss sends a rookie, Solid Snake, on a mission to destroy Metal Gear, a nuclear-armed bipedal walking tank developed by Outer Heaven. After completing this mission, Solid Snake pursues the specter of Big Boss to Zanzibar Land.

 In “Metal Gear” and “Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake” for the MSX2, the spotlight passes to a new hero: Solid Snake. PlayStation®2 ports of these two classics are also included in “Metal Gear Solid 3: Subsistence”.

Shadow Moses Incident

It is the dawn of the 21st century. The Special Forces unit FOXHOUND seizes control of a nuclear weapons disposal facility on Shadow Moses, an isolated rock in Alaska’s Fox Islands. They present their demands to the government: hand over the remains of the legendary hero Big Boss within 24 hours, or FOXHOUND will launch a nuke. In response, the government summons Solid Snake out of seclusion in the Alaskan wilderness and sends him on a solo mission to infiltrate Shadow Moses.

Released for the PlayStation®, “Metal Gear Solid” combines exciting live-action and polygon-rendered cutscenes and 3D CG action scenes, with innovative gameplay, all while delivering an anti-war, anti-nuke message.

Tanker Incident, Big Shell Incident

In 2007, a tanker sinks in the middle of New York Bay. The disaster is orchestrated by Solid Snake, who is believed lost at the bottom of the sea along with the tanker...

Two years later, the floating Big Shell facility is constructed for the ostensible purpose of cleaning up the oil spilled by the tanker. But the Big Shell is taken over by the terrorist group “Sons of Liberty”. With the US President held hostage, the government sends Raiden, a new recruit in the new FOXHOUND, to infiltrate the Big Shell.

Metal Gear Solid 2 utilizes the full capabilities of the PlayStation®2 to present dazzling visuals and a fully immersive game environment.

”SHOP INFO”
Exchange DP (Drebin Points) collected during the game for exclusive wallpapers.

Different wallpapers require different amounts of DP. Save up your DP by playing the game multiple times.

The Drebin's Shop screen shows a list of wallpapers you can currently trade for.

The DP required for each wallpaper is displayed in the list. Your current DP is shown in the upper right of the screen.

To make a purchase, first check to see if you have enough DP, then tap the ”BUY” button.

Tap the ”VIEW” button to display wallpapers on the screen. Use the screenshot function to take pictures of them. (See the Apple website for details on wallpaper settings.)

* DP and wallpaper download history will be reset if ”METAL GEAR SOLID TOUCH” is deleted from the device.

ACT 1: LIQUID SUN

War has changed.
The massive expansion of PMCs (private military corporations) has turned war into a business. Monitored by advanced ID control systems, soldiers fight wars not for ideology or belief but for profit.

In this battlefield of total control, dominated by mercenaries for hire and man-made war machines, one man stands apart. That man is Solid Snake, the ”Legendary Hero,” who has saved the world countless times from the menace of nuclear terrorism. With his gray hair and deeply lined face, Snake's world-weary appearance has earned him a new nickname - Old Snake.

An urgent request from his old friend Roy Campbell brings the now aged Snake back into the thick of battle. His mission: to assassinate Liquid Ocelot, leader of Outer Heaven, the mother company that controls the 5 largest PMCs - a man whose existence Snake is determined to end by his own hand. Backed by overwhelming military force, Liquid is preparing to launch an insurrection. He has been sighted in a Middle Eastern war zone.

The region is in the midst of a protracted ”cold civil war” between rebel militias and the forces of Praying Mantis, a PMC hired by the current regime.

entries.source: As he makes his way through the battlefield, Snake encounters Drebin, a ”gun launderer.” Dressed in a handsome designer suit hardly befitting a war zone, Drebin is the sole arms dealer capable of removing the locks on ”ID guns” controlled by the system. With no ID of his own and relying on non-controlled ”naked guns”, Snake faces a difficult road ahead. He accepts Drebin's offer - strictly business - and returns to battle. He finds himself in the middle of a firefight with an unmanned attack chopper.

Snake makes contact with his ”informants” - Rat Patrol Team 01, a US Army PMC investigation unit led by Snake's former comrade Meryl Silverburgh, who still looks barely a day over 20. Meryl claims that Liquid's insurrection cannot possibly succeed as long as the nanomachines injected into every soldier and the IDs implanted in every weapon are under the control of the SOP (Sons of the Patriots) battlefield control system.

Snake is unconvinced, believing that Liquid must have something in mind. But just as he asks Meryl where Liquid is, they are suddenly attacked by Haven Troopers, private soldiers under Liquid's personal control.

ACT 2: SOLID SUN

Having escaped from the Haven Troopers, Snake hurries toward the PMC camp where Liquid was spotted. He finally catches sight of Liquid. But then, without warning, he is engulfed by a sudden wave of madness that overtakes the PMC soldiers, allowing his nemesis to escape.

The soldiers lose their senses - blacking out, vomiting, total confusion - attacking their comrades and themselves as well... and then Snake, too, feels his senses begin to fail him. But why? Perhaps he can find answers from Naomi Hunter, the genetic engineering and nanomachine expert who accompanies Liquid. After all, it was she who injected him 9 years earlier with an older version of nanomachines during the Shadow Moses Island Incident.

Snake now pursues Naomi's trail to the next battlefield, South America, in search of Liquid - and his own salvation.

ACT 4: TWIN SUNS

Snake has defeated another member of the B&B Corps, Raging Raven. But it is already too late. Liquid has used Big Boss's body, the key to cracking the SOP system, to launch the ”Guns of the Patriots.” ”We are victorious!” Liquid cries as Big Boss's body - and Big Mama along with it - are engulfed by flames from his cannon blast. All soldiers and weapons on battlefields everywhere have fallen under Liquid's control. With nothing left to drive the gears of war, an unprecedented, almost ironic calm now falls over the world.

But Liquid still needs one more thing to complete his overthrow of the Patriots. Nuclear weapons alone remain outside the SOP system's control, kept under a higher level of security. To destroy the military satellite housing the Patriots' core AI, Liquid must find a way to launch his own nuclear strike. And there is only one source of nukes outside the Patriots' control: Metal Gear REX, abandoned on Shadow Moses Island before the creation of SOP.

Realizing Liquid's intentions, Snake and his allies fly to Shadow Moses, the location of the first fateful confrontation between Liquid and Snake.

In a fight to the death with Raiden, Vamp's nanomachine protection fails at last, and his unnatural life comes to an end. Naomi stays by his side, bidding farewell to the beast she created. Then she, too, takes her last breath. For Naomi, it is an act of atonement for her regretful past. It was her healing nanomachines that turned Vamp into a deathless monster, and it was her genetic sequencing program that laid the foundation for the Patriots' SOP system.

A cascade of rubble rains down Naomi's cold, lifeless body, burying her sins with her. With no time to mourn her death, Otacon activates Metal Gear REX. Snake and Raiden escape to the island's harbor. But Liquid is there waiting for them, piloting the anti-Metal Gear weapon Metal Gear RAY. The metallic roars from these two man-made beasts echo across the frozen wastes of Shadow Moses.

ACT 5: OLD SUN

Liquid has disappeared to the bottom of the sea along with his Arsenal Class battleship, Outer Haven. Snake pursues him aboard the old USS Missouri, a Naval Training ship still outside the system's control.

The young captain of the Missouri, Mei Ling, calculates the location where Outer Haven is likely to appear - the location from which Liquid must launch his nuclear warhead against the satellite housing the Patriots' AI. Mei Ling explains that the brief time in which Outer Haven surfaces to launch its warhead is their last remaining chance. But in order to thwart Liquid's plan and take back the stolen control system, someone will have to board Outer Haven and upload a self-destruct worm cluster program directly into GW, the machine interface for the AI network. Risking almost certain death, a few brave solders volunteer for the mission, and Snake will be the anchor man for the team. 

As the sun rises over the horizon, Outer Haven finally appears. Snake and his team commence their entry onto the deck of the enemy ship, where a section of Liquid's elite troops await them.

Ocelot lies motionless before Snake's eyes, his fiery spirit extinguished at last. The battle is over. The final mission is complete. 

The ”Legendary Hero” kneels on the deck, exhausted. Just then, he hears a voice - ”Snake!” Otacon, the man who has watched over him all through the battle, has come to rescue him. The Haven Troopers have lost their will to fight and are taken into custody by US soldiers. Raiden, Meryl, and the others are at Snake's side. Free from the bonds of the system, the world has been granted at least a temporary respite from its troubles.

The scars left by the Patriots' system and Liquid's rebellion against it run deep. They will take time to heal.

And yet...

The sun will rise once again tomorrow over those who remain.

That's a PMC checkpoint. Can't believe they even brought a Gekko into town... but your mission is to break through and make sure Big Boss's body stays safe. You don't have time to fool around with war machines. Avoid fighting the Gekko and take out those Haven Troopers first.

entries.source:
Raging Raven...
She's got a ”Slider” UCAV (unmanned combat aerial vehicle) strapped to her back that allows her to fly. It'll be tough to draw a bead on her, so pay close attention to her movements, keep your cool, and aim carefully. She'll team up with her other Sliders to attack you, and you'll need to watch out for cluster bombs, too.

Crying Wolf...
She is armored in a steel suit that is impenetrable to normal gunfire. To defeat Wolf, wait for her unguarded moment as she prepares to fire the railgun. Use that instant to counterattack. You'll only have a brief moment, but it's your only chance. Make the first move and focus all you've got on those shots!

You want to know how to use weapons?
Trace your finger across the screen to move the sight. Get a target in your sight and then tap the screen to fire. Tap it repeatedly for automatic fire. You can tap anywhere on the screen. There's no need to tap on the targets themselves.

Defense Walls?
You can hide behind walls by taking your finger off the screen. As long as you're behind a wall, you won't take damage. Stay there long enough and you'll recover LIFE. Take cover behind the walls until the coast is clear.

entries.source:
You want to know how to switch weapons?
To switch weapons, just pinch the screen. Pinch out (spread two fingers apart) to switch to the SVD, and pinch in (close two fingers together) for the M4. Use the M4 against enemies at close range, and the SVD for enemies farther out. You'll be needing this move later on, so I'd take this chance to get it down pat.

entries.source:
The SVD?
The SVD is a sniper rifle capable of attacking enemies at long range. It doesn't have the automatic fire of the M4, but it's got a scope for more precise shots, and it's powerful, too. The drawbacks are that it limits your field of vision, and you can't hide behind walls even when you lift your finger from the screen. Use it wisely.

entries.source:
How's that Solid Eye working for you?
The circular gauges above each target represent tactical data from the Solid Eye, a set of all-purpose goggles. The inner circle is the target's remaining LIFE. The outer circle is the TIME until they make their next move.

The color of the inner LIFE gauge shows the target's range. White means short to medium range, while gray means long range. The M4 can only hit short- and medium-range targets. Use the SVD to attack targets with gray life gauges.

The RPG-7?
The RPG-7 is a rocket launcher that launches a powerful attack across a wide area. Some enemies have too much LIFE to go down in 1 or 2 hits, while others are so tough they can't be damaged by the M4 or SVD at all. That's where the RPG-7 comes in handy.

Looks like an uphill battle...
The Dwarf Gekko is a compact-sized UGV (Unmanned Ground Vehicle) that works in tandem with the Gekko, performs reconnaissance, and scouts out enemies. Due to being a reconnaissance tool, it's not equipped with much combat power, however it's a completely different story when they attack as a group. Defeat the Dwarf Gekko as they appear one by one so you don't become overwhelmed by their numbers.

It's the puppets! The 2 puppets that Mantis is holding are controlling the nanomachines in the bodies of those she is manipulating. That's the reason why you're not landing your shots and why the dead are able to stand. It's all the puppets' doing. Shoot the puppets and take them from her.

entries.source:
You want to know about the Mantis Doll?
The Mantis Doll is a puppet that can manipulate living things. It appears that you were able to get away with not being completely controlled, thanks to your old-generation nanomachines. If you can manage to take the Mantis Doll, you'll be able to inflict damage on Mantis by shaking the device.

You want to know about the Sorrow Doll?
The Sorrow Doll is a puppet that can manipulate the dead. The puppet is probably using electrical impulses to move the muscles of the corpse. In any case, if you can manage to take the Sorrow Doll, the now soul-less Haven Troopers should not be getting back up.

Just a little more Snake!
Considering the battles that you've gone through so far, you should now be familiar with how to combat the enemy forces. This mission will require you to put that knowledge and those techniques to work. Defeat the Dwarf Gekko that lie ahead and guide the Mk.III to the server room.

entries.source:
Hang in there, Snake!
The Dwarf Gekko is a compact-sized UGV (Unmanned Ground Vehicle) that works in tandem with the Gekko, performs reconnaissance, and scouts out enemies.  Due to being a reconnaissance tool, it's not equipped with much combat power, however it's a completely different story when they attack as a group. Defeat the Dwarf Gekko as they appear one by one so you don't become overwhelmed by their numbers.

entries.source:
Liquid!
His attacks are comprised of a left/right straight, a left uppercut, and a strong right. It's possible to guard against all of his attacks, however you can't completely protect yourself against the damage from the left uppercut or the strong right. Avoid these attacks by ducking.

Argh...
Reckless attacks alone will not defeat Liquid. Watch his attacks carefully and guard and duck to deal with them. Use the opening after his attacks to move in with a 3 consecutive-hit combo... Defeat Liquid and put an end to our cursed fate!

Having a rough time, eh, Snake?
Haven Troopers are Liquid's own elite unit of troops. Their full-body power suits enhance their combat abilities in every way.  When fighting them, it's best to keep a close eye on their TIME gauge and master the timing needed to guard their attacks.

In some missions, there are situations where there is no defense wall from the start.
